authority: JAYT-389 — directive supplied directly by user
reviewer: Codex CEO; Gemini only after an actual independent artifact review

prohibitions: Do not bypass CAPTCHA, WAF, authentication, rate limits, geo restrictions, robots controls, paywalls or provider terms.
Do not manufacture, edit, truncate or reconstruct source bytes, terms, screenshots, prices, stock, media, promotion codes or provider attribution records.
A challenge, login, generic catalogue, search result, redirect, HTTP 404 or blocked capture is missing evidence, not verified product/deal evidence.

tasks: Use a compliant browser/session to capture each exact SKU detail-page response only where access is legitimately granted.
Persist original response bytes as 06_TRUST_AND_EVIDENCE/j389/raw_snapshots/sku_raw_<itemId>.<html|json|webarchive>. Do not store merely metadata or a preview.

Each leaf must bind relative file path, physical byte size, SHA-256 from the saved byte file, final URL, response status, capture timestamp, source-extracted product/variant, merchant, price, availability and delivery terms.

Validator must require physical file byte size to equal declared body_length_bytes and hash to equal declared raw_content_sha256; it must reject challenge/blocked/redirect/404 status for verification.
If a SKU cannot be obtained compliantly, keep it unverified and count it openly.
Acquire one correctly matched product photograph per verified SKU only from an official merchant/manufacturer source with documented right/basis for the storefront use.
Save a non-hotlinked WebP or PNG under 03_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH/assets/products/; record source URL, source relation to SKU/variant, capture time, MIME type, dimensions, bytes and SHA-256 in the leaf.
Set VERIFIED_MERCHANT_MEDIA only after manual 1:1 visual verification. Any unavailable media stays LABELED_NEUTRAL_PLACEHOLDER and is excluded from the verified count.
Build must decode each claimed photo and reject reuse, generic imagery, mismatched SKU/variant, SVG placeholder, absent source record or hash mismatch.
Remove all jayt.vn self-referential source URLs from the evidence set.
Store one retained first-party partner artifact per deal at 06_TRUST_AND_EVIDENCE/j389/deals/, with path, byte size, SHA-256, capture time and first-party source URL in the index.

Each record must prove the exact offer, effective date, eligibility, local Da Nang applicability and redemption route. Copy-code CTA requires a visible real public code; app/counter CTA must exactly match the source.

Metiz, CGV, Starlight, Phe La, Katinat and Highlands are acquisition targets, not pre-approved factual claims. Do not publish an ordinary price, expired campaign or generic membership benefit as a deal.
For each provider, retain a redacted provider-issued and replayable attribution validation that binds provider, SKU, attributed destination and accepted test/reporting record.
Partner ID, affiliate query parameter, redirect construction, click count or executor-authored JSON alone never proves attribution or revenue.
Enable affiliate_enabled only for the verified provider/SKU scope. All others remain direct official-link mode, with a clear non-affiliate disclosure and no revenue claim.

release_gate: Run equality validation across source registry, UI cards, worker catalogue, SKU leaves and physical artifacts. Include mutation tests for ID, URL, product/variant, price, media, declared bytes/hash, challenge status and missing file.
Require 30/30 compliant raw-byte artifacts and 30/30 verified, rights-documented media before claiming completion of the SKU workstream.
Require 15/15 retained first-party deal artifacts before claiming a qualified local-deal set.
Re-run SSRF, itemId-only, mixed-DNS and HTTP-status tests; 3xx must remain UNKNOWN. Verify 1440/768/390 with no console errors or overflow.
CEO must independently inspect artifacts and served bytes. No production commercial activation, no is_approved=true claim, and no affiliate provider flag until every relevant gate passes.

reporting.ack: Record actual acknowledgement and start time.
reporting.progress: Report verified raw-byte count, challenge/blocked count, verified photo count, verified deal count and attribution-ready provider count, plus exact blockers.
reporting.completion: Never report a target count as complete when a required byte artifact, photo, first-party source or provider proof is missing.
